scientific_integrity: Infinite generating-function identity is derived from an exact transfer identity and checked symbolically; Gaussian limit is proved analytically from its simple dominant pole; finite direct enumeration is a cross-check, not an infinite certificate. Prior scalar counts are not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: For ordinary P3-convex sets on open two-row path ladders only. Size coefficients and sharp endpoint statistics are specified; prior unweighted sequence counts for n>=2 and prior related cyclic transfer enumeration are credited. No wider grid result, local limit theorem, or independent validation.
title: Cardinality spectrum and boundary-size law for \(P_3\)-convex sets on open ladders
